assessment.compile_experiment: deferred until a joint-evaluation candidate has separate equivalent-output evidence
assessment.rule: All paired outputs exact, all calls complete, no sample overflow, and median actually sampled scalar wall / profiled STT wall >= 10%. No extrapolated samples or speedup claim.
assessment.interpretation: Scalar readbacks materialize pending MLX work. This includes decoder/joint/entropy dependencies, not just host conversion. Stage intervals are nested; never sum all stages.

pairing: Control/candidate order alternates by repeat + item index; same loaded model and source. No scalar/stage timing probes or extra synchronization on control. No calls discarded, including first call per mode.

candidate_method.materialization: mx.eval(token_argmax, unchanged_entropy_confidence, duration_argmax) once per greedy step before same int/float reads
